# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a young woman with lovely fair curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears sleeve puffs bigger than anyone else's in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is bright, sympathetic, and cheerful. She possesses the gift of winning and holding the affections of her pupils, bringing out the best in them mentally and morally. She handles misbehavior gently and forgivingly, keeping perfect order without resorting to corporal punishment.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired as the new teacher for Avonlea school, becoming the town's first female teacher. Upon taking charge, she introduced physical culture exercises every morning and evening, bi-weekly Friday afternoon recitations, and field days in the woods to study nature. She also taught her pupils proper speech and corrected common grammatical errors. During her tenure, she prepared a group of pupils known as the Queen's class for their Entrance examinations, encouraging them to pursue higher studies. Although offered a position in her home district's grade school after her first year, she returned to Avonlea to complete her term before her rule at the school came to an end at the close of June.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c31 P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v2 c17 P18](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0018)_
